# tasks-tui

<!-- ops:identity start — generated by ops-docs; edit identity.toml -->
*A keyboard-driven terminal front end for the tasks tracker*

For people who keep their work in tasks: browse projects and their tasks, file, edit, start, park and close them, and launch an agent harness on a task in a new terminal. It shells out to the tasks CLI and reads its JSON, so the CLI stays the only writer.

Authority: `docs/guide.md`, `docs/tasks-contract.md`
<!-- ops:identity end -->

## Install

Requires [tasks](https://github.com/khughitt/tasks): its binary must be on `PATH`. Building
needs Go.

    go install github.com/khughitt/tasks-tui/cmd/tasks-tui@latest

From a checkout:

    just setup      # deps and git hooks
    just install    # installs tasks-tui and the short command tui

Either way the binary lands in Go's binary directory (`go env GOBIN`, else
`$GOPATH/bin`), which must be on `PATH`. Only `just install` creates the `tui` symlink;
after `go install`, alias it or link it yourself.

## Usage

    tui                 # Projects view, or the project you are standing in
    tui --all           # Projects view even inside a registered project
    tui tui             # one project by prefix
    tui tui-1a2b3c      # one task
    tui --config path   # a config file other than the default

A project opens on five tabs: Ready, Doing, Open, Ideas, Done.

### Keys

`?` shows the legend in the app. Chords (`c …`, `s …`, `S …`, `g g`) wait up to 900 ms
for their second key.

| | |
|---|---|
| move | `j`/`k` or Up/Down · `h`/`l` or Left/Right switch tabs · `tab`/`shift+tab` cycle tabs · `1`–`5` pick a tab · `g g`/Home top (Project and Task views) · `G`/End bottom (Project view) · `pgup`/`pgdn` (`ctrl+b`/`ctrl+f`) page the Task view and the legend |
| open | `enter`/`i` open · `esc` back · `/` filter · `F5` reload |
| sort | `s p` priority · `s a` age · `s t` title, ascending; `S` as the prefix sorts descending. In Projects, `p` is prefix and `a` is activity |
| task | `a` add · `e` edit · `space` start · `p` park · `d` done · `x` drop · `y` copy id in the Task view |
| launch | `c l` Claude · `c o` Codex · `c r` Crush · `c O` OpenCode · `c c` picker |
| app | `?` legend · `W` console · `q` quit (or close a panel) |

Add and edit open a centered form for title, body, and tags. Tab or Shift+Tab move
between fields, Ctrl+S saves, Escape cancels. In tags, Enter accepts a suggestion and
Up/Down choose among matches from the current project.

Launching opens a new terminal in the task's checkout and hands the harness a prompt
naming the task; the prompt and every command are configurable below.

## Configuration

`~/.config/tasks-tui/config.toml`, or `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/tasks-tui/config.toml` when that
is set (every key optional; unknown keys are an error):

```toml
tasks = "tasks"
refresh_seconds = 30

[launch]
terminal = ["kitty", "--directory", "{dir}", "--"]
prompt = "Run `tasks start {id}` and continue that task: {title}"

[launch.harness.claude]
command = ["claude", "{prompt}"]

[launch.harness.codex]
command = ["codex", "{prompt}"]

[launch.harness.opencode]
command = ["opencode", "--prompt", "{prompt}"]

[launch.harness.crush]
command = ["crush"]

```

`{dir}` is the task's checkout, `{id}` and `{title}` the task, `{prompt}` the rendered
prompt. A harness table may also carry `env`, variables added to that harness's
environment (over any inherited value of the same name); a table that sets only `env`
keeps the default command:

```toml
[launch.harness.crush]
env = { TASKS_MAX_COMPLEXITY = "mid" }
```

A new harness table needs a `command`, and appears in the `c c` picker.

Project labels and task IDs use the authored `color` returned by `tasks projects`;
256-color terminals use its supplied `color_256` index. Basic-color terminals keep
project labels neutral. Ordinary text follows the terminal foreground; semantic
red/yellow/cyan roles and inactive dim text follow its ANSI theme. The
[guide](docs/guide.md#colours) describes selection, logarithmic blue–cyan–gold
count shading, the separate cyan recency fade and terminal queries. The home
table omits Name; names remain searchable and visible in Project details.

Upgrading from the familiar-based version: remove the old `[identity]` table
from your config. It is no longer supported and is reported as an unknown key.
The app no longer reads familiar files or queries project git remotes.

## Layout

- `cmd/tasks-tui/`: the binary: flags, config loading, startup probe.
- `internal/`: the subprocess boundary to `tasks` (`tasksctl`), the Bubble Tea views
  (`ui`), harness launch, config and project colours.
- `docs/`: the [user guide](docs/guide.md) and [the tasks contract](docs/tasks-contract.md).
- `tools/`: test helpers and tooling vendored from
  [ops](https://github.com/khughitt/ops); see [tools/README.md](tools/README.md).

## Documentation

- [Guide](docs/guide.md): the views, changing tasks, where commands run, launching an
